video_title: Mad Max Sees Allen Iverson in Darius Acuff's Game

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff's high-volume shooting and efficiency as a rookie
quotes.excerpt: This kid is averaging 26 points while shooting 40 percent from the field
quotes.quote: Darius Acuff. A lot of people are questioning how many shots he gets, can he make it, can he be efficient. This kid is averaging 26 points while shooting 40 percent from the field and 31 from the three-point line, averaging six assists a game, but getting up 24 shots.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Darius Acuff's rookie volume to Allen Iverson's early career
quotes.excerpt: I think Allen Iverson would have been a whole another level of rockstar if there was social media

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: I want to compare his numbers to Allen Iverson's because a lot of people are talking about his ability to get that many shots up as a rookie. Iverson averaged 20 shots a game, 23 a game, 41 from the field and 34 from the three-point line. So pretty similar numbers. I always wonder what it would have been like, because I think Allen Iverson would have been a whole another level of rockstar if there was social media around when he first came in the league.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: Right, right.

And that's the way he plays. That's what the fuck he do. I don't give a damn where he plays. He is going to get them up.
